create_olmo_hybrid_config: create an OlmoHybridConfig instance with default architecture parameters for the OLMo Hybrid model
create_olmo_hybrid_custom_layers: create an OlmoHybridConfig with custom layer_types specifying full_attention and linear_attention patterns
create_olmo_hybrid_gqa: create an OlmoHybridConfig with grouped query attention by setting num_key_value_heads separately from num_attention_heads
create_olmo_hybrid_linear_params: create an OlmoHybridConfig with custom linear attention head dimensions and gating parameters
test_olmo_hybrid_config_defaults: test the OlmoHybridConfig default initialization produces expected vocab_size, hidden_size, and layer_types
